W2_problem_analysis.name: Credit Assignment Noise in CTDE
W2_problem_analysis.context: Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE) suffers from high-variance policy gradients due to noisy credit assignment, where individual agents cannot distinguish their contribution from team reward.

W3_solution_directions.name: Optimal Transport Credit Assignment
W3_solution_directions.context: Use optimal transport to align agent contributions with reward signals, providing a principled way to distribute credit.

W3_solution_directions.name: Shapley Value Credit Assignment
W3_solution_directions.context: Use Shapley values from cooperative game theory to quantify each agent's marginal contribution.
